summary: First testing iteration on InverIA stock analysis app. Tested all backend APIs (21 pytest tests) and frontend flows. All backend endpoints pass: quote/chart/indicators/news/popular/watchlist CRUD/alerts CRUD/analyze for all 3 LLM models (gpt-5.2, claude-sonnet-4.5, gemini-3-flash). Frontend renders correctly with AAPL by default, search works (TSLA loaded), timeframe selector, model selector dropdown shows all 3 models, AI analysis generates recommendation (MANTENER w/ 62% confidence rendered), watchlist/alerts/popular sidebar tabs and all indicator panel tabs (Momentum/Tendencia/Niveles/Patrones) function.

ui_bugs.issue: Price level labels (R:, S:, SL:, TP1, TP2) overlap visually on the right edge of the chart - text becomes unreadable when multiple levels are close together

issues: Recharts width(-1) height(-1) console warning on initial render due to ResponsiveContainer mounting before layout settles; cosmetic only, chart renders fine after

action_items: Optional: improve chart reference-line label positioning to avoid overlap (offset labels vertically or use a legend)
Optional: set explicit minHeight on chart container to silence Recharts width(-1) warning on first paint
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider FastAPI lifespan handlers
Watchlist POST returns 200 instead of 201 (Created) - minor REST convention
ai_analysis.py json.loads fallback may still raise on malformed responses; consider wrapping with explicit error
No rate limiting on /api/analyze - could be abused given LLM cost
seed_data_creation: Test watchlist for NVDA and test alert for AAPL@999 created and cleaned up within tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all endpoints incl. all 3 LLM models. Frontend tested via Playwright; all key data-testids implicitly available via text/role selectors. Default symbol on load is AAPL. Watchlist returns 409 on duplicate as expected.
